content:
As the 2026 World Cup draws to a close, Major League Soccer (MLS) will return to Apple TV tomorrow, with Apple Maps, Apple Sports, Apple Fitness+ and other platforms rolling out related features simultaneously. Details are as follows:

MLS Returns to Apple TV

Apple is today highlighting the return of "Apple League Soccer", with six matches scheduled over the coming days:

July 16 (Thursday):

  • CF Montréal vs. Toronto FC (7:30 PM ET)
  • Chicago Fire vs. Vancouver Whitecaps (8:30 PM ET)
  • St. Louis City SC vs. Sporting Kansas City (8:30 PM ET)
  • Seattle Sounders vs. Portland Timbers (10:30 PM ET)

July 17 (Friday):

  • Nashville SC vs. Atlanta United FC (8:10 PM ET)
  • LA Galaxy vs. LAFC (10:15 PM ET)

To celebrate the return of the regular season, Apple has announced a range of MLS-themed features across its platforms, including a new "Time to Walk" audio experience for Apple Fitness+ subscribers.

The latest episode is hosted by German football legend Thomas Müller, who "reflects on the effort he put in before his rise to professional stardom, and shares why he embraces the challenge of major life transitions".

Apple Music will also launch exclusive playlists curated by players, including Diego Luna of Real Salt Lake and Evander da Silva Ferreira of FC Cincinnati. Team-themed playlists for the New York Red Bulls, New York City FC, Orlando City SC and other clubs spanning the East and West conferences will also be available.

On Apple Maps, Apple will introduce "matchday guides created by MLS clubs, as well as city tours personally recommended by players, helping users discover local restaurants, popular attractions, detailed stadium information and more".

Fans using the Apple Sports app can stay up to date with the latest league news at any time, including real-time scores, standings, match updates, lineups and team statistics.

Finally, Apple stated:

MLS matches are available for free to Apple TV subscribers in over 100 countries and regions worldwide. Apple will also provide exclusive content and access to all cup competitions and playoffs throughout the season.

For more coverage from Apple on the return of MLS, click here.

Apple TV costs US$12.99 per month, and is also available through an Apple One bundle. The platform offers a wide range of popular series and films, including Severance, The Studio, The Morning Show, Busy Town and Silo, among others.
